entries.title: Psalms 142:1
segments: ¶<<Maschil of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave.>> I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication. {Maschil...: or, A Psalm of David, giving instruction}

words.text: when he was in the cave
. {Maschil...: or, A Psalm of David, giving instruction}

entries.title: Psalms 142:2
segments: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 142:3
segments: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

entries.title: Psalms 142:4
segments: ¶I looked on [my] right hand, and beheld, but [there was] no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul. {I looked...: or, Look on the right hand, and see} {failed...: Heb. perished from me} {cared...: Heb. sought after}

words.text: , but [there was] no man that would know
. {I looked...: or, Look on the right hand, and see} {failed...: Heb. perished from me} {cared...: Heb. sought after}

entries.title: Psalms 142:5
segments: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou [art] my refuge [and] my portion in the land of the living.

entries.title: Psalms 142:6
segments: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

entries.title: Psalms 142:7
segments: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
